source.prompts: six public synthetic chat prompts defined in scripts/probe_kv_selection.py; two disjoint sets of three

method.inspiration: MPCache (arXiv:2501.06807); independent deterministic static selection oracle, not its private dynamic gather
method.oracle: unmodified full prefill and full allocated KV cache; in every following decode attention head use fixed first/spaced and recent positions, preserving absolute RoPE positions
method.matching: same-token selected-logit and free-generation token agreement versus independent unfiltered same-checkpoint output

network_gate.why: Current compiled prepared path evaluates attention and KV on the client; the transform changes attention-width and protected-state requirements, not remotely exchanged linear tensor widths. The transformed schedule is rejected, so 0 is a conditional stage-body projection, not a measured request.
network_gate.related_distinct_control: 175+1-token prefix-reuse comparison at docs/evidence/client-prefix-reuse-qwen25-2026-09-28.json measured 279291648 warm online body bytes without reuse; not a 175+8 KV-selection benchmark

conclusion: Six public prompts show selection fidelity depends on input cohort and policy; 16 retained positions' 24/24 primary agreement falls to 17/24 same-token and 18/24 free-generation agreement on confirmation. No protected dynamic selection, all-link byte savings, or whole-decoder execution is established.
reproduction: OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 uv run --no-sync python scripts/probe_kv_selection.py
OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 MKL_NUM_THREADS=4 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=4 uv run --no-sync python scripts/probe_kv_selection.py --confirmation
